columns.comment: News item id from the news vendor feed (NEWS-...).
columns.name: news_id

columns.comment: Date the item was published (the grain date).
columns.name: published_date

columns.comment: Publication timestamp (UTC) as delivered by the vendor.
columns.name: published_ts

columns.comment: First day of the calendar month of publication.
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: External company-master id (ext_company_master) the vendor tagged the item to.
columns.name: company_id

columns.comment: Listed-parent / rated-issuer id of the group when the vendor tagged one (joins fact_market_signal_daily.issuer_id); null otherwise.
columns.name: issuer_id

columns.comment: Fictional news outlet, e.g. Kilowatt Asia Monitor, Bluewater Freight Journal.
columns.name: outlet

columns.comment: News source type: Business Press, Newswire, Trade Press or Company Filing.
columns.name: source_type

columns.comment: Synthetic headline (at most 20 words; fictional entities only).
columns.name: headline

columns.comment: Synthetic one-sentence summary (at most 40 words).
columns.name: summary

columns.comment: News topic: Expansion, M&A, Earnings, Management Change, Rating Action, Regulatory, Litigation, ESG Controversy or Supply-Chain Disruption.
columns.name: topic

columns.comment: Finer topic, e.g. Coal Regulation, Market Entry, Results In Line, Data Centre Build-out.
columns.name: subtopic

columns.comment: Unified-feed signal code raised by the item (NEWS_<TOPIC>, e.g. NEWS_EXPANSION, NEWS_REGULATORY); join gold.dim_signal_type.
columns.name: signal_code

columns.comment: Polarity of the item as a signal: Opportunity (sentiment >= 0.2), Risk (sentiment <= -0.2), else the signal type's default polarity (Opportunity, Risk or Neutral).
columns.name: signal_polarity

columns.comment: Vendor sentiment score -1 (very negative) .. +1 (very positive); synthetic, deterministic (D18). Average it, never sum.
columns.name: sentiment_score

columns.comment: Sentiment label from the score: Negative (<= -0.2), Positive (>= 0.2) or Neutral.
columns.name: sentiment_label

columns.comment: True when the sentiment score is <= -0.2 (a negative item).
columns.name: is_negative

columns.comment: True when the sentiment score is >= 0.2 (a positive item).
columns.name: is_positive

columns.comment: Vendor relevance of the item to the client 0-1 (1 = the client is the main subject).
columns.name: relevance

columns.comment: ISO-2 country the item reports from (e.g. SG, ID, AU).
columns.name: region

columns.comment: Language of the item (en).
columns.name: language

columns.comment: Sector cycle theme of the client's industry: Coal (Oil, Gas & Coal and Mining), Shipping, Renewables (Renewables and Power Generation), Data Centres & Digital, or Other - for coal / shipping / renewables sentiment trends.
columns.name: sector_theme

columns.comment: Days between the publication date and the as-of date 30-Sep-2026 (0 = as-of day); last N days = days_before_as_of < N.
columns.name: days_before_as_of

columns.comment: True for items published in the 30 days to 30-Sep-2026 (1-Sep-2026 .. 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: is_last_30d

columns.comment: True for items published in the 90 days to 30-Sep-2026 (3-Jul-2026 .. 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: is_last_90d

columns.comment: True for items published in the 90 days before that window (4-Apr-2026 .. 2-Jul-2026) - compare with is_last_90d for a sentiment change.
columns.name: is_prior_90d

columns.comment: Average sentiment of all news on the client's group in the last 90 days to 30-Sep-2026 (group attribute as of today, same on every row of the group; null = no recent news).
columns.name: group_sentiment_last_90d

columns.comment: Average sentiment of the group's news in the prior 90 days (4-Apr-2026 .. 2-Jul-2026); null = none.
columns.name: group_sentiment_prior_90d

columns.comment: True when the group's last-90-day average sentiment is below zero and below its prior-90-day average (or it had no earlier news) - a group with a negative news trend as of 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: is_group_negative_trend

comment: External news items about APAC clients (fictional news vendor, synthetic text): headline, summary, topic (Expansion, M&A, Earnings, Management Change, Rating Action, Regulatory, Litigation, ESG Controversy, Supply-Chain Disruption), vendor sentiment score -1..1 (synthetic, D18) with its label (Negative <= -0.2, Positive >= 0.2), relevance and the signal code it raises in the unified feed (fact_signal_event). Each item is tagged to one golden client (and its group). Flow fact: count items and average the sentiment; window flags (last 30 / 90 days, prior 90 days) are relative to the as-of date 30-Sep-2026. Grain: one row per news item.
